text:
irina: Heads-up: need to lock KMS/HSM escrow & evidence segmentation for SOC2 Q3 roadmap. Customers asking for per-tenant key separation + legal hold retention options. @tom_k can you call out MVP scope?

 tom_k: We can do tenant-scoped CMKs + HSM-backed root key for now. Tradeoffs: cost and snapshotting complexity. Need to decide retention windows and exportability.

 priya: Legal needs explicit audit trail for key usage + export controls. Also need retention freeze for legal hold (indefinite).

 legal_ops: Correct — for litigation holds we must preserve evidence and impressions of key accesses. We should scope 'evidence snapshot' export API.

 darren: Ops: HSM-backed roots increase run costs ~30% at scale. Alternative: use KMS + envelope with per-tenant KEKs in software for lower cost but weaker isolation.

 maria_p: @irina @tom_k customers we piloted last month prefer strong isolation even with higher cost, but only for enterprise customers.

 irina: Launch criteria proposal: (1) SOC2 evidence export, (2) per-tenant key separation, (3) audit logs with signed timestamps, (4) legal-hold freeze. MVP could limit to 'enterprise' plan. Thoughts?

 tom_k: Agree. For MVP, limit HSM to Dedicated/private deployments. Hosted customers get KMS per-tenant envelope keys. We'll add quantifiable SLA: key usage logs retained 1 year by default.

 priya: Retention policy snippet for docs? ```json
{
  "default_retention_days": 365,
  "legal_hold": true,
  "export_format": "signed-zip"
}
```

 ops_infra: We need exact storage estimate: 100K keys x 365 days logs -> ~2TB of logs incl indexing. Need budget approval.

 irina: :thumbsup: Action items: Tom to write RFC for scope + implementation plan by Tue, Darren to model cost numbers, Legal to draft export spec. I'll route to PMs for OKR inclusion.

 tom_k: On it. I'll post RFC link here when ready.

 security-bot: Reminder: add deprecation window and rollback plan for key rotation changes — incident playbook template: /playbooks/key-rotation

 legal_ops: One more: require KMS/HSM attestation artifact in the audit packet. We'll define acceptance criteria.

 irina: Thanks everyone — we'll keep scope tight. If no objections I'll mark this as confirmed and slot into Q3 security roadmap.
